_note: Round 10 (B): staff personality text. `quotes` are the one-line 'why me' a candidate says on the hiring sheet, by staffArchetypes id (a role id works as a fallback). `likes` / `dislikes` are the labels for sim-core personality.ts LIKE_IDS / DISLIKE_IDS (every id must be present). Keep lines short, friendly and readable by a 10-year-old.

chef_commis: I've been cooking with my gran since I was six!
I'm new, but I learn really fast. Teach me anything.
I can peel a whole sack of potatoes before lunch.
I want to be a head chef one day. This is step one!
I make the best scrambled eggs in my street.
chef_line: Give me a busy grill and I'm happy.
I've worked in three kitchens. I never burn the chips.
I keep my station tidy and my plates hot.
Saturday night rush? Bring it on.
I can cook ten things at once and smile.
chef_experienced: I've cooked for a duke. Your guests will love me.
My sauces are famous. Ask anyone.
I'll teach your other chefs a trick or two.
Twenty years in kitchens. I've seen it all.
Food should make people happy. Mine does.
server: I remember every guest's name. And their pudding.
I can carry four plates without a wobble!
I love chatting to people. Grumpy guests leave smiling.
I'm quick on my feet and I never forget an order.
Big tables, little tables: I'll look after them all.
bar: I make a fizzy lemonade that sparkles like magic.
I can pour a drink while telling a joke.
Behind the bar is my happy place.
I know a hundred drinks. Well, ninety-nine.
I'll keep the drinks flowing and the queue short.
porter: I make pans shine like mirrors.
Mountains of washing-up don't scare me.
A clean kitchen is a happy kitchen. I'm on it.
I'm the fastest dishwasher in town. Probably.
I'll keep the plates coming so the chefs never run out.
manager: I love a good plan and a tidy rota.
I keep everyone cheerful, even on Mondays.
I'll make sure nobody gets too tired.
Happy team, happy guests. That's my rule.
I've run a café before. I know the ropes.
